hypotheses.Q0_exact_tensor_map_recomposes_coefficie: The symmetric quadratic forms derived from native weights reproduce pooled rank-32 coefficients with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_weight_rank64_is_sufficient: The shared weight-canonical input rank 64 reaches causal fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of the full rank-32 oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_weight_rank128_is_sufficient: The shared weight-canonical input rank 128 reaches causal fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_weight_subspace_beats_random: At input ranks 32, 64, and 128, weight-canonical fidelity exceeds matched random-subspace fidelity by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_weight_subspace_beats_state_pca: At input rank 64, weight-canonical fidelity exceeds FineWeb state-PCA fidelity by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q5_one_compact_input_space_transfers_ood: Some shared input rank at most 128 passes the 0.70/within-0.15 gate on all three corpora.
hypotheses.Q6_quadratic_map_repairs_linear_wikitext: On WikiText, weight-canonical rank 128 exceeds the prior best linear local-router fidelity 0.607 by at least 0.10.
